usage: Refers to drums as a musical instrument; in Cantonese, 鼓 is the general noun for a drum or drum set in music talk.
Commonly used with size or type words, such as 一個鼓, 大鼓, 細鼓, when counting or describing different drums.
Often appears in compound words and set phrases related to percussion and rhythm, so it’s very natural in band, school, and music contexts.
Neutral and everyday in register; beginners can use it freely when talking about instruments, performances, or learning music.
